messages:
Mia Chen: quick question — inside the role editor, can we show an "effective routing + quota" preview per-route? customers keep asking what granting X role actually means for route throttles and routing tiers.
Dan O'Leary: yes, we should. currently the editor only shows scope names, no runtime effects.
Akash Patel: curious — do you mean a live calculation (server-side) or an approximation (client-side heuristic)?
Mia Chen: ideally server-side accurate, but we need to balance latency. a cached computed view would be ok.
Lina Gómez: from UX POV we want a compact row per route: route name, effective quota, routing tier (e.g. dedicated/hosted/fallback), and a short reason tooltip.
Sophie Tran: +1. Also highlight when role change would remove the route from dedicated tier -> that’s a big regression for customers. red warning badge.
Dan O'Leary: backend debate — we can either call existing /auth/evaluate API for each route at render time, or add a new bulk endpoint that computes effective privileges for a role across N routes. the evaluate API is slow per-call.
Akash Patel: we should add a bulk endpoint. prototype idea: POST /admin/roles/:id/eval-effective with body {"routes": ["/v1/generate","/v1/embeddings"], "preview": true} returns map of route->{allowed, quota, routingTier, reason}. doable.
Mia Chen: that looks good. Dan — what are perf concerns?
Dan O'Leary: main issues: auth graph traversal + quota policy lookup + routing policy heuristics. on-demand compute for 200 routes could be heavy. we should cache results per role+route, TTL 5m, and compute incrementally.
Lina Gómez: can we stream partial results? editor could render top routes first.
Akash Patel: yes — return ordered chunks, or SSE. simpler: return top N fast, mark others as "computing".
Sophie Tran: telemetry requirement: we need to record which previews were viewed and which role edits triggered a preview, for rollout metrics. keep counts and sample payloads for privacy.
Dan O'Leary: agree. add a telemetry event preview.viewed {role_id, route_count, compute_time_ms, sample_flag} and preview.compute.error.
Mia Chen: rollout plan suggestion: feature flag behind console-rollouts.preview-effective-v1, canary 10% orgs first, then 50% with monitoring on compute latency and error rate.
Akash Patel: migration note: bulk endpoint needs to respect entitlements like `tenant_bound` and `scoped_tokens`. must run under role of UI actor (no elevation). will surface "reason" for denied due to tenant mismatch.
Lina Gómez: UX microcopy: for denied routes show "Not available for this role in current tenant — see details" with link to policy docs.
Sophie Tran: sample telemetry thresholds: alert if median compute_time > 500ms or error_rate > 2% in canary.
Dan O'Leary: dev plan: 1) add bulk endpoint + caching layer, 2) add telemetry hooks, 3) console render changes + placeholders, 4) feature flag + canary rollout. estimate 2 sprints backend + 1 sprint frontend.
Mia Chen: can we also include a small inline code sample for API consumers? e.g.:
```
POST /admin/roles/rol_abc/eval-effective
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "routes": ["/v1/generate","/v1/chat"],
  "preview": true
}
# response: {"/v1/generate": {"allowed": true, "quota": "10k/mo", "routingTier": "dedicated", "reason": "role has dedicated_access"}, ...}
```
Akash Patel: looks good. implement caching key: role_id + sorted routes + tenant_id + policy_version. TTL 300s.
Sophie Tran: do we need an opt-out for telemetry at org level? enterprise customers might ask. add a console toggle and honor it.
Dan O'Leary: yes — telemetry respects org preferences. also ensure sampled payloads are scrubbed (no user tokens etc).
deploy-bot: canary rollout started for feature flag console-rollouts.preview-effective-v1 on 10% of orgs. :rocket:
Mia Chen: sweet. next: Dan/Akash will draft API PR and Lina/Sophie will mock a compact row in figma. I'll own rollout checklist.
Dan O'Leary: assigning PR to @Akash for backend, tagging me for telemetry review.
Akash Patel: working on it tomorrow, will post a short design doc + perf numbers once I have proto.
Lina Gómez: will share mock by end of week.
Sophie Tran: adding telemetry alert runbook to the checklist.
Mia Chen: thanks all — good sync.
